evidence: LiF deposition consists of alternating pulse and purge of lithium tertkbutoxide (99%, Alfa Aesar) and TiF4 (Sigma Aldrich) as precursors. A typical pulse and purge durations for lithium tertkbutoxide subkcycle are 1s and 15s, respectively. A typical pulse and purge durations for TiF4 subkcycle are 0.1s and 15s, respectively.
